headline: A verified evidence base for a 15 February – 23 March 2027 New York trip for 2 adults, with two real dated 7-night hotel quotes, official in-window booking deadlines, and every remaining unconfirmed value left blank and flagged.

key_points.title: Dates
key_points.text: Four real date options are costed by weekday: 15–18 Feb (3 nights, preferred), 15–22 Feb (7 nights, primary), 15 Feb–1 Mar (14 nights), 15 Feb–15 Mar (28 nights). 15 Feb 2027 is Washington's Birthday, a U.S. federal holiday.

key_points.title: Cheapest verified booking window
key_points.text: NYC Hotel Week 2027 (2 Jan–11 Feb 2027, 25% off) ends before the requested window. Two official in-window offers were verified instead: Arlo Hotels Cyber Exclusive Access (40% off, book by 3 Dec 2026, code CYBER, NYC stays through 31 Oct 2027) and Marriott CYBER SALE at citizenM (15%/25% off, book by Tuesday 1 Dec, code QRI, stays 29 Nov 2026–2 May 2027). No official source proves a market-wide cheapest price.

key_points.title: MICHELIN picture
key_points.text: The current official NYC listing shows 69 starred restaurants: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star; plus 76 Bib Gourmand and 224 Selected (no star). The full 2025 star roster, 13 individually re-verified starred restaurants, and the November/July/April 2026 Guide-listed new additions are catalogued with official links and explicit star-vs-listed status.

key_points.title: Restaurant detail
key_points.text: 13 starred restaurants have verified addresses, per-day opening hours, exceptions, official site links and social review links. Verified menu subtotals for 2 are published for Le Bernardin, Eleven Madison Park and The Modern; other totals are blank.

key_points.title: Activities
key_points.text: 11 activities have official links, days/hours/exceptions and social review links where verifiable. The High Line's official winter hours (7 AM–8 PM, 1 Dec–31 Mar) cover the entire trip window.

key_points.title: Hotels
key_points.text: 6 candidate hotels are documented with official sources. Two real 7-night quotes for 15–22 Feb 2027 were captured: Pod 51 Queen Pod $1,109 incl taxes & fees (Pod Member Rate) and Arlo NoMad Queen $1,296 incl urban fee but excl taxes (The Steal Deal). Pod 51 is the only hotel with both a queen bed and a private bathroom confirmed verbatim, and the lowest verified all-in total. Four totals remain blank.

key_points.title: Cluster / travel analysis
key_points.text: Starred restaurants are grouped into clusters using ZIP codes on official MICHELIN pages; a verified same-ZIP view puts citizenM (10019) at 3, Pod 51 (10022) at 1 and Arlo (10016) at 1 of the 13 detailed starred restaurants. The requested 'within 1 hour by subway or bus' count cannot be verified from a static official source; those numbers and the resulting hotel ranking remain blank, with an MTA Trip Planner workflow supplied instead.

key_points.title: Decision status
key_points.text: 7 of 12 questions still block a decision (dates, complete hotel totals, market-wide booking timing, room requirements, transit counts, star-list currency, itinerary feasibility). Two hotel quotes and two official booking deadlines are now partially answered; none of the remaining gaps were filled with guesses.

key_points.title: Site & governance
key_points.text: A mobile-friendly static dashboard with category subpages, a machine-readable data corpus, an automated build/verification script, a dedicated Suggestions page and a Flagged for Review page. Parallel-session scopes are recorded in COORDINATION.md; the other session's root site is preserved as a separate artifact.
